DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They’re in single-target or priority-add scenarios (active_enemies >=1) with optimal cooldown planning active
  • Their Gargoyle is active with ≤22s remaining, or they’re using Army of the Dead with either an Abomination under 18s remaining or Army Ghouls at ≤18s
  • Dark Transformation is active during multi-target scenarios (≥3 enemies) or while Death and Decay is active
  • Their Gargoyle won’t be available to use within 10s of Power Infusion’s duration (requires cooldown tracking)
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • The Priest is in Voidform and Power Infusion is not active
  • Dark Ascension is active and Power Infusion is not active
  • The Priest has the TWW 2 4-Piece Set Bonus active and Power Infusion is not active
